```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  rubocop:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Run TypeScript lint
        run: yarn lint

  graphql_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Run GraphQL lint
        run: yarn graphql-lint

  factory_bot_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run FactoryBot lint
        run: bundle exec rake factory_bot:lint

  rspec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      RAILS_ENV: test
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Setup database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          bundle exec rspec --format documentation --format RspecJunitFormatter --out test_results/rspec.xml
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rspec-results
          path: test_results/rspec.xml
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: coverage/**

  db_seed:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      RAILS_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Setup database
        run: |
          bundle exec rails db:create db:migrate
      - name: Seed database
        run: bundle exec rails db:seed
```
